literal_meaning: ছোটখাটো ঘর্ষণ বা খটকা (নট: ছোট বা অদ্ভুত, খট: ঘর্ষণ)
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই পরিবারের মধ্যে নটখটি লেগেই আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: There has been a petty quarrel between the two families for a while.
There is some minor friction going on between the neighbors.
note: This idiom is commonly used in everyday Bengali conversation to describe ongoing small conflicts without deep animosity.
